LanguageData.EventsMod_EnableCompression_Label: Enable event text compression (WIP - coming soon, toggle currently does nothing)
LanguageData.EventsMod_EnableCompression_Tooltip: Use compressed event text to reduce token usage when sending quests and events to RimAI.Communication.
LanguageData.EventsMod_Compression_Description:
When enabled, RimAI.Events will compress long, repetitive quest descriptions while keeping key facts.
Example (refugee hospitality quest): - Before: A long multi-paragraph letter explaining who the refugees are, why they fled, how long they will stay, and that they will work and fight for free... - After: A short summary like: "The colony accepted the refugees. They fled for [reason], will stay for X days to rest, and will work and fight for free during that time."
When disabled, RimAI.Events always sends the full original event text.
LanguageData.EventsMod_CategoryFilters_Desc: Enable or disable entire event categories. Disabled categories are completely hidden from the AI, overriding all settings below.
LanguageData.EventsMod_TypeBasedFiltering_Desc: Hide all events of selected types globally, across all saves
LanguageData.EventsMod_InstanceBasedFiltering_Desc: Hide specific active events in this save. Only available when a save is loaded.
LanguageData.EventsMod_CurrentEventsNote: Shows only events currently active in your game. Only available when a save is loaded.
LanguageData.EventsMod_AllEventTypesNote: Shows all possible event types from loaded mods. May include event types that are already excluded from RimAI.Communication conversations, even if active in your game (e.g., background timers, diplomacy quests).
LanguageData.EventsMod_QuickFilter_Sites: World Sites (bandit camps, item stashes, etc.)
LanguageData.EventsMod_InstanceFiltersCleared: Cleared {0} instance filter(s) across all saves.
LanguageData.EventsMod_EnhancedPromptDetected_Desc: Enhanced Prompt's "Auto Event Capture" is enabled. Overlapping features are disabled to ensure compatibility with Enhanced Prompt's own event tracking system.
LanguageData.EventsMod_EnableContextFilteringTooltip: Only append quest events that involve pawns in the current conversation (nearby pawns, speaker, recipient). Threats, map conditions, and site parts are always included. Saves tokens and (might) improves LLM focus.
LanguageData.EventsMod_ContextFiltering_Description: When enabled, quests that don't involve any pawns in the current conversation (nearby pawns, speaker, recipient) will be skipped. This reduces token usage and (might) help the LLM focus on relevant events. However, when enabled, pawns will never talk about such quests if the related pawns are not nearby.
LanguageData.EventsMod_AppendToContext_Tooltip: When enabled, ongoing events are automatically appended to the {{context}} variable in RimAI.Communication prompts.
LanguageData.EventsMod_AppendToContext_Desc: Disable this if you prefer to use {{eventplus_all}}, {{eventplus_quests}}, {{eventplus_conditions}}, {{eventplus_threats}}, or {{eventplus_location}} individually in your Advanced Mode templates.
LanguageData.EventsMod_MandatoryLockToggle: Override conflict-prevention lock (Enhanced Prompt Auto Event Capture)
LanguageData.EventsMod_MandatoryLockToggle_Tooltip: RimAI.Events locks event category filters when Enhanced Prompt's auto event capture is active, to prevent conflicts between their tracking systems. Enable to override this lock and control filters manually.
LanguageData.EventsMod_MandatoryLockToggle_Desc: RimAI.Events enforces a mandatory category lock when Enhanced Prompt's auto event capture is detected, as both systems track events and may conflict. Only enable this if you want manual filter control despite the potential conflict.
